content.short: DirectEd Development Foundation builds Cardano-based scholarship crowdfunding for African coding students.
content.description: DirectEd Development Foundation is building a decentralized application for scholarship crowdfunding, starting with coding bootcamp support for high-potential students in Kenya and Ethiopia. The project focuses on transparency by design, using blockchain tools so donors can verify that funds reach the right students and are used for the intended purpose. By combining Atala PRISM-style identity ideas with smart contract workflows, DirectEd turns charitable giving into a more accountable education funding process.
